messages.content: What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?

message.content:
In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild winter weather:

| Time | Average Temperature |
|------|---------------------|
| Daytime highs | ~13–16 °C (55–61 °F) |
| Night‑time lows | ~7–10 °C (45–50 °F) |

So you can expect comfortable daytime temperatures just above 60 °F, while evenings dip into the mid‑40s. Rainfall is relatively light—about 2–5 mm per month on average—and sunshine remains plentiful.
